_comment: SpaceMiT K3 three-model workload: mlp_control 1600 Hz, dronet 480 Hz, yolov8_nano 64 Hz. cpu_p = X100 (CPUs 0-7, rvv_k3), cpu_e = A100 (CPUs 8-15, ime_k3_a100). Hyperperiod 62.5 ms = 100 x 0.625 = 30 x 2.0833 = 4 x 15.625. Profiles measured on the board into gen/k3_board_profiles. Variant: singletons (one core per dispatch). Used by scripts/k3_walker_feedback/ (static vs dynamic walker, global pool, calibrated feedback).
_topo_comment: topo_tag_override is false so each width block is costed from its own N-hart profile (topo tag derived from the combination); true would charge every block the 1-hart time.
_instances_comment: num_instances pinned (as in the K1 spec) so solves stay comparable.
